verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה עַתָּ֣ה תִרְאֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֖ה לְפַרְעֹ֑ה כִּ֣י בְיָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ יְשַׁלְּחֵ֔ם וּבְיָ֣ד חֲזָקָ֔ה יְגָרְשֵׁ֖ם מֵאַרְצֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh ‘at·tāh ṯir·’eh ’ă·šer ’e·‘ĕ·śeh lə·p̄ar·‘ōh kî ḇə·yāḏ ḥă·zā·qāh yə·šal·lə·ḥêm ū·ḇə·yāḏ ḥă·zā·qāh yə·ḡā·rə·šêm mê·’ar·ṣōw
verses.literal: But the LORD said to Moses Now you will see what I will do to Pharaoh for because of My mighty hand he will let the people go because of My strong hand he will drive them out of his land
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO disse o SENHOR a Moisés: Agora verás o que hei de fazer a Faraó; porque por uma mão poderosa os deixará ir, sim, por uma mão poderosa os lançará de sua terra.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖יו אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- mō·šeh way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: God also told . . . Moses - I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Falou mais Deus a Moisés, e disse: Eu sou o SENHOR.

verses.original: וָאֵרָ֗א אֶל־ אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶל־ יִצְחָ֥ק וְאֶֽל־ יַעֲקֹ֖ב בְּאֵ֣ל שַׁדָּ֑י וּשְׁמִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לֹ֥א נוֹדַ֖עְתִּי לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ê·rā ’el- ’aḇ·rā·hām ’el- yiṣ·ḥāq wə·’el- ya·‘ă·qōḇ bə·’êl šad·dāy ū·šə·mî Yah·weh lō nō·w·ḏa‘·tî lā·hem
verses.literal: I appeared to Abraham to Isaac and to Jacob as God Almighty but by My name the LORD I did not make Myself known to them
verses.literalPt: E eu apareci a Abraão, a Isaque, e a Jacó, como o Deus Todo-Poderoso; mas pelo meu nome, o SENHOR, não lhes fui perfeitamente conhecido.

verses.original: וְגַ֨ם הֲקִמֹ֤תִי אֶת־ בְּרִיתִי֙ אִתָּ֔ם לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶ֖ם אֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן אֵ֛ת אֶ֥רֶץ מְגֻרֵיהֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־ גָּ֥רוּ בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam hă·qi·mō·ṯî ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî ’it·tām lā·ṯêṯ lā·hem ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an ’êṯ ’e·reṣ mə·ḡu·rê·hem ’ă·šer- gā·rū ḇāh
verses.literal: I also established My covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan the land . . . where they lived as foreigners
verses.literalPt: E também estabeleci a minha aliança com eles, para dar-lhes a terra de Canaã, a terra de suas peregrinações, na qual foram peregrinos.

verses.original: וְגַ֣ם׀ אֲנִ֣י שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי אֶֽת־ נַאֲקַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִצְרַ֖יִם מַעֲבִדִ֣ים אֹתָ֑ם וָאֶזְכֹּ֖ר אֶת־ בְּרִיתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ’ă·nî šā·ma‘·tî ’eṯ- na·’ă·qaṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer miṣ·ra·yim ma·‘ă·ḇi·ḏîm ’ō·ṯām wā·’ez·kōr ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî
verses.literal: Furthermore I have heard the groaning of the Israelites whom the Egyptians are enslaving and I have remembered My covenant
verses.literalPt: E também tenho ouvido o gemido dos filhos de Israel, aos quais os egípcios fazem servir, e lembrei-me da minha aliança.

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֥ר לִבְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל אֲנִ֣י יְהוָה֒ וְהוֹצֵאתִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֗ם מִתַּ֙חַת֙ סִבְלֹ֣ת מִצְרַ֔יִם וְהִצַּלְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵעֲבֹדָתָ֑ם וְגָאַלְתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ בִּזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּבִשְׁפָטִ֖ים גְּדֹלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ĕ·mōr liḇ·nê- yiś·rå̄·ʾēl ’ă·nî Yah·weh wə·hō·w·ṣê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem mit·ta·ḥaṯ siḇ·lōṯ miṣ·ra·yim wə·hiṣ·ṣal·tî ’eṯ·ḵem mê·‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯām wə·ḡā·’al·tî ’eṯ·ḵem biz·rō·w·a‘ nə·ṭū·yāh ū·ḇiš·p̄ā·ṭîm gə·ḏō·lîm
verses.literal: Therefore tell the Israelites . . . I am the LORD and I will bring you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians and deliver you from their bondage I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with mighty acts of judgment
verses.literalPt: Portanto dize aos filhos de Israel: Eu sou o SENHOR, e vos tirarei de debaixo das cargas dos egípcios, e vos livrarei da servidão, e vos resgatarei com braço estendido e com grandes juízos.

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתִּ֨י אֶתְכֶ֥ם לִי֙ לְעָ֔ם וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָכֶ֖ם לֵֽאלֹהִ֑ים וִֽידַעְתֶּ֗ם כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם הַמּוֹצִ֣יא אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִתַּ֖חַת סִבְל֥וֹת מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem lî lə·‘ām wə·hā·yî·ṯî lā·ḵem lê·lō·hîm wî·ḏa‘·tem kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ham·mō·w·ṣî ’eṯ·ḵem mit·ta·ḥaṯ siḇ·lō·wṯ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: I will take you as My own people and I will be your God Then you will know that I am the LORD your God who brought you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians
verses.literalPt: E eu vos tomarei por meu povo, e serei vosso Deus; e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus, que vos tiro de debaixo das cargas dos egípcios;

verses.original: וְהֵבֵאתִ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ אֶל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֙אתִי֙ אֶת־ יָדִ֔י לָתֵ֣ת אֹתָ֔הּ לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֑ב וְנָתַתִּ֨י אֹתָ֥הּ לָכֶ֛ם מוֹרָשָׁ֖ה אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·ḇê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer nā·śā·ṯî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî lā·ṯêṯ ’ō·ṯāh lə·’aḇ·rā·hām lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ū·lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’ō·ṯāh lā·ḵem mō·w·rā·šāh ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: And I will bring you into the land that I swore - to give to Abraham Isaac and Jacob I will give it to you as a possession I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: E eu vos levarei à terra, acerca da qual levantei minha mão, jurando que a daria a Abraão, a Isaque e a Jacó, e vo-la darei por herança, eu o SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֛ה כֵּ֖ן אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֤א שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה מִקֹּ֣צֶר ר֔וּחַ וּמֵעֲבֹדָ֖ה קָשָֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr mō·šeh kên ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō šā·mə·‘ū ’el- mō·šeh miq·qō·ṣer rū·aḥ ū·mê·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh qā·šāh
verses.literal: Moses relayed this message to the Israelites . . . but on account of their broken spirit and cruel bondage they did not listen to him
verses.literalPt: Deste modo falou Moisés aos filhos de Israel, mas eles não ouviram a Moisés, por causa da angústia de espírito e da dura servidão.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: So the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Falou mais o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

verses.original: בֹּ֣א דַבֵּ֔ר אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם וִֽישַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bō ḏab·bêr ’el- par·‘ōh me·leḵ miṣ·rā·yim wî·šal·laḥ ’eṯ- bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mê·’ar·ṣōw
verses.literal: Go and tell . . . Pharaoh king of Egypt to let the Israelites . . . go out of his land
verses.literalPt: Entra, e fala a Faraó rei do Egito, que deixe sair os filhos de Israel da sua terra.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵ֤ן בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֹֽא־ שָׁמְע֣וּ אֵלַ֔י וְאֵיךְ֙ יִשְׁמָעֵ֣נִי פַרְעֹ֔ה וַאֲנִ֖י עֲרַ֥ל שְׂפָתָֽיִם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr mō·šeh lip̄·nê Yah·weh lê·mōr hên bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl lō- šā·mə·‘ū ’ê·lay wə·’êḵ yiš·mā·‘ê·nî p̄ar·‘ōh wa·’ă·nî ‘ă·ral śə·p̄ā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: But in the LORD’s . . . presence Moses replied If the Israelites . . . will not listen to me then why would Pharaoh listen to me since I am unskilled in speech
verses.literalPt: Moisés, porém, falou perante o SENHOR, dizendo: Eis que os filhos de Israel não me têm ouvido; como, pois, Faraó me ouvirá? Também eu sou incircunciso de lábios.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹן֒ וַיְצַוֵּם֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם לְהוֹצִ֥יא אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn way·ṣaw·wêm ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’el- par·‘ōh me·leḵ miṣ·rā·yim lə·hō·w·ṣî ’eṯ- bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron and gave them a charge . . . concerning both the Israelites . . . . . . and Pharaoh king of Egypt to bring the Israelites . . . out of the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Todavia o SENHOR falou a Moisés e a Arão, e deu-lhes mandamento para os filhos de Israel, e para Faraó rei do Egito, para que tirassem os filhos de Israel da terra do Egito.

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֣י בֵית־ אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּנֵ֨י רְאוּבֵ֜ן בְּכֹ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל חֲנ֤וֹךְ וּפַלּוּא֙ חֶצְר֣וֹן וְכַרְמִ֔י אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת רְאוּבֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh rā·šê ḇêṯ- ’ă·ḇō·ṯām bə·nê rə·’ū·ḇên bə·ḵōr yiś·rā·’êl ḥă·nō·wḵ ū·p̄al·lū ḥeṣ·rō·wn wə·ḵar·mî ’êl·leh miš·pə·ḥōṯ rə·’ū·ḇên
verses.literal: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, were Hanoch and Pallu Hezron and Carmi These were the clans of Reuben
verses.literalPt: Estas são as cabeças das casas de seus pais: Os filhos de Rúben, o primogênito de Israel: Enoque e Palu, Hezrom e Carmi; estas são as famílias de Rúben.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֗וֹן יְמוּאֵ֨ל וְיָמִ֤ין וְאֹ֙הַד֙ וְיָכִ֣ין וְצֹ֔חַר וְשָׁא֖וּל בֶּן־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֑ית אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת שִׁמְעֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê šim·‘ō·wn yə·mū·’êl wə·yā·mîn wə·’ō·haḏ wə·yā·ḵîn wə·ṣō·ḥar wə·šā·’ūl ben- hak·kə·na·‘ă·nîṯ ’êl·leh miš·pə·ḥōṯ šim·‘ō·wn
verses.literal: The sons of Simeon were Jemuel Jamin Ohad Jachin Zohar and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman. These were the clans of Simeon
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Simeão: Jemuel, Jamin, Oade, Jaquim, Zoar e Saul, filho de uma cananéia; estas são as famílias de Simeão.

verses.original: וְאֵ֨לֶּה שְׁמ֤וֹת בְּנֵֽי־ לֵוִי֙ לְתֹ֣לְדֹתָ֔ם גֵּרְשׁ֕וֹן וּקְהָ֖ת וּמְרָרִ֑י וּשְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י לֵוִ֔י שֶׁ֧בַע וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים וּמְאַ֖ת שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ bə·nê- lê·wî lə·ṯō·lə·ḏō·ṯām gê·rə·šō·wn ū·qə·hāṯ ū·mə·rā·rî ū·šə·nê ḥay·yê lê·wî še·ḇa‘ ū·šə·lō·šîm ū·mə·’aṯ šā·nāh
verses.literal: These were the names of the sons of Levi according to their records Gershon Kohath and Merari Levi lived 137 . . . . . . years
verses.literalPt: E estes são os nomes dos filhos de Levi, segundo as suas gerações: Gérson, Coate e Merari; e os anos da vida de Levi foram cento e trinta e sete anos.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י גֵרְשׁ֛וֹן לִבְנִ֥י וְשִׁמְעִ֖י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ḡê·rə·šō·wn liḇ·nî wə·šim·‘î lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām
verses.literal: The sons of Gershon were Libni and Shimei by their clans
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Gérson: Libni e Simei, segundo as suas famílias;

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י קְהָ֔ת עַמְרָ֣ם וְיִצְהָ֔ר וְחֶבְר֖וֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵ֑ל וּשְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י קְהָ֔ת שָׁלֹ֧שׁ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים וּמְאַ֖ת שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê qə·hāṯ ‘am·rām wə·yiṣ·hār wə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn wə·‘uz·zî·’êl ū·šə·nê ḥay·yê qə·hāṯ šā·lōš ū·šə·lō·šîm ū·mə·’aṯ šā·nāh
verses.literal: The sons of Kohath were Amram Izhar Hebron and Uzziel Kohath lived 133 . . . . . . years
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Coate: Anrão, Izar, Hebrom e Uziel; e os anos da vida de Coate foram cento e trinta e três anos.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י מְרָרִ֖י מַחְלִ֣י וּמוּשִׁ֑י אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַלֵּוִ֖י לְתֹלְדֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê mə·rā·rî maḥ·lî ū·mū·šî ’êl·leh miš·pə·ḥōṯ hal·lê·wî lə·ṯō·lə·ḏō·ṯām
verses.literal: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi These were the clans of the Levites according to their records
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Merari: Mali e Musi; estas são as famílias de Levi, segundo as suas gerações.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח עַמְרָ֜ם אֶת־ יוֹכֶ֤בֶד דֹּֽדָתוֹ֙ ל֣וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֔ה וַתֵּ֣לֶד ל֔וֹ אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְאֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וּשְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י עַמְרָ֔ם שֶׁ֧בַע וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים וּמְאַ֖ת שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ‘am·rām ’eṯ- yō·w·ḵe·ḇeḏ dō·ḏā·ṯōw lōw lə·’iš·šāh wat·tê·leḏ lōw ’eṯ- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’eṯ- mō·šeh ū·šə·nê ḥay·yê ‘am·rām še·ḇa‘ ū·šə·lō·šîm ū·mə·’aṯ šā·nāh
verses.literal: And Amram married . . . his father’s sister Jochebed and she bore him Aaron and Moses Amram lived 137 . . . . . . years
verses.literalPt: E Anrão tomou por mulher a Joquebede, sua tia, e ela deu-lhe Arão e Moisés: e os anos da vida de Anrão foram cento e trinta e sete anos.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י יִצְהָ֑ר קֹ֥רַח וָנֶ֖פֶג וְזִכְרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê yiṣ·hār qō·raḥ wā·ne·p̄eḡ wə·ziḵ·rî
verses.literal: The sons of Izhar were Korah Nepheg and Zichri
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Izar: Corá, Nefegue e Zicri.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י עֻזִּיאֵ֑ל מִֽישָׁאֵ֥ל וְאֶלְצָפָ֖ן וְסִתְרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ‘uz·zî·’êl mî·šā·’êl wə·’el·ṣā·p̄ān wə·siṯ·rî
verses.literal: The sons of Uzziel were Mishael Elzaphan and Sithri
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Uziel: Misael, Elzafã e Sitri.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־ אֱלִישֶׁ֧בַע בַּת־ עַמִּינָדָ֛ב אֲח֥וֹת נַחְשׁ֖וֹן ל֣וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַתֵּ֣לֶד ל֗וֹ אֶת־ נָדָב֙ וְאֶת־ אֲבִיה֔וּא אֶת־ אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאֶת־ אִֽיתָמָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lî·še·ḇa‘ baṯ- ‘am·mî·nā·ḏāḇ ’ă·ḥō·wṯ naḥ·šō·wn lōw lə·’iš·šāh wat·tê·leḏ lōw ’eṯ- nā·ḏāḇ wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ḇî·hū ’eṯ- ’el·‘ā·zār wə·’eṯ- ’î·ṯā·mār
verses.literal: And Aaron married . . . Elisheba the daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon and she bore him Nadab and Abihu Eleazar and Ithamar
verses.literalPt: E Arão tomou por mulher a Eliseba, filha de Aminadabe, irmã de Naasson; e ela deu-lhe Nadabe, Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י קֹ֔רַח אַסִּ֥יר וְאֶלְקָנָ֖ה וַאֲבִיאָסָ֑ף אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַקָּרְחִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê qō·raḥ ’as·sîr wə·’el·qā·nāh wa·’ă·ḇî·’ā·sāp̄ ’êl·leh miš·pə·ḥōṯ haq·qā·rə·ḥî
verses.literal: The sons of Korah were Assir Elkanah and Abiasaph These were the clans of the Korahites
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Corá: Assir, Elcana e Abiasafe; estas são as famílias dos coraítas.

verses.original: וְאֶלְעָזָ֨ר בֶּֽן־ אַהֲרֹ֜ן לָקַֽח־ ל֨וֹ מִבְּנ֤וֹת פּֽוּטִיאֵל֙ ל֣וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֔ה וַתֵּ֥לֶד ל֖וֹ אֶת־ פִּֽינְחָ֑ס אֵ֗לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַלְוִיִּ֖ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el·‘ā·zār ben- ’a·hă·rōn lā·qaḥ- lōw mib·bə·nō·wṯ pū·ṭî·’êl lōw lə·’iš·šāh wat·tê·leḏ lōw ’eṯ- pî·nə·ḥās ’êl·leh rā·šê ’ă·ḇō·wṯ hal·wî·yim lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām
verses.literal: Aaron’s son Eleazar married one of the daughters of Putiel and she bore him Phinehas These were the heads of the Levite families by their clans
verses.literalPt: E Eleazar, filho de Arão, tomou por mulher uma das filhas de Putiel, e ela deu-lhe a Finéias; estes são os cabeças dos pais dos levitas, segundo as suas famílias.

verses.original: ה֥וּא אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּמֹשֶׁ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ לָהֶ֔ם הוֹצִ֜יאוּ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם עַל־ צִבְאֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hū ’a·hă·rōn ū·mō·šeh ’ă·šer ’ā·mar Yah·weh lā·hem hō·w·ṣî·’ū ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ‘al- ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: It was this Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said Bring the Israelites . . . out of the land of Egypt by their divisions
verses.literalPt: Estes são Arão e Moisés, aos quais o SENHOR disse: Tirai os filhos de Israel da terra do Egito, segundo os seus exércitos.

verses.original: הֵ֗ם הַֽמְדַבְּרִים֙ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֔יִם לְהוֹצִ֥יא אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם ה֥וּא מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: hêm ham·ḏab·bə·rîm ’el- par·‘ōh me·leḵ- miṣ·ra·yim lə·hō·w·ṣî ’eṯ- bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mim·miṣ·rā·yim hū mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn
verses.literal: Moses and Aaron were the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt in order to bring the Israelites . . . out of Egypt . . .
verses.literalPt: Estes são os que falaram a Faraó, rei do Egito, para que tirasse do Egito os filhos de Israel; estes são Moisés e Arão.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּי֨וֹם דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·yō·wm dib·ber Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Now on the day that the LORD spoke to Moses in Egypt
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que naquele dia, quando o SENHOR falou a Moisés na terra do Egito,

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹ֖ר אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה דַּבֵּ֗ר אֶל־ פַּרְעֹה֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י דֹּבֵ֥ר אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr ’ă·nî Yah·weh dab·bêr ’el- par·‘ōh me·leḵ miṣ·ra·yim ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ’ă·nî dō·ḇêr ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: He said to him . . . I am the LORD tell . . . Pharaoh king of Egypt everything I say to you
verses.literalPt: Falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo: Eu sou o SENHOR; fala a Faraó, rei do Egito, tudo quanto eu te digo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הֵ֤ן אֲנִי֙ עֲרַ֣ל שְׂפָתַ֔יִם וְאֵ֕יךְ יִשְׁמַ֥ע אֵלַ֖י פַּרְעֹֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh lip̄·nê Yah·weh hên ’ă·nî ‘ă·ral śə·p̄ā·ṯa·yim wə·’êḵ yiš·ma‘ ’ê·lay par·‘ōh
verses.literal: But in the LORD’s presence Moses replied Since I am unskilled in speech why would Pharaoh listen to me
verses.literalPt: Então disse Moisés perante o SENHOR: Eis que eu sou incircunciso de lábios; como, pois, Faraó me ouvirá?
